run_order_lifecycle_tests: run the integration tests that create an order, add items, checkout, and complete it
run_product_search_tests: run the tests that search products by name and verify product details like price
run_order_item_tests: run the tests that add and remove items from an order and verify the order state
run_order_error_tests: run the tests that verify HTTP error codes for invalid order operations like missing or invalid IDs
run_endpoint_error_tests: run the tests that verify 404 and 405 responses for unknown endpoints and disallowed methods
